questions.question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80d21cba4806e7b6bf5e93df119777eec63e95efec191eba8a7c0881c4de2fb1.png]
questions.solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : first column

 
• Alternately elements in first column shifts to third column diagonally.
 
• Alternately element in second column remains constant.
 
• Alternately element in third column shifts to first column.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d31be274934820bbc67a9ac76a80a29ad3b2660bf593ddf61ba0ac771aa4983.png] 

2) For second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately first row elements shifts in the anti-clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately element in second column is replaced by new element i.e 'Y' is replaced by '6' and '6' is replaced by 'C'.
 
• Alternately second row elements shifts in the clockwise direction. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2ccb970ea4d79f4937fdb2b516f3a5abc0c02e9a0b9e567e91433520277cf9b.png] 

The final series is :

Hence, ‘option - (3)’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: 14 is related to 57 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 22 is related to 89 . To which of the following is 52 related to, following the same logic?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number × 4) + 1 = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 14 is related to 57

⇒ (14 × 4) + 1

⇒ 56 + 1 = 57.

For, 22 is related to 89

⇒ (22 × 4) + 1

⇒ 88 + 1 = 89.

Similarly, for **52 related to**

**⇒ (52 × 4) + 1**

**⇒ 208 + 1 = 209.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, You have to decide which conclusion's logically follows from the given statements.

**Statements:**

All buckets are plastic.

Some plastic are spoons.

All spoons are forks.

**Conclusion I: **Some plastic are buckets

**Conclusion II: **Some plastics are forks.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Statement:

All buckets are plastic.

Some plastic are spoons.

All spoons are forks.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/279eb751a6e18a49fb53f06c5d3787bff2aa90ff7538309a16e7d741744e4365.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some plastic are buckets → **True** (It is given that all bucket are plastic. It simply means that some plastic are buckets.)

II. Some plastics are forks → **True **(It is given that some plastic are spoons and all spoons are forks. It simply means that the part of spoon which is plastic is also fork.)

So, **both conclusions follow.**

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 2'.***

questions.question: 5 is related to 20 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 7 is related to 26. To which of the following is 2 related to, following the same logic?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number × 3) + 5 = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 5 is related to 20

⇒ (5 × 3) + 5

⇒ 15 + 5 = 20.

For, 7 is related to 26

⇒ (7 × 3) + 5

⇒ 21 + 5 = 26.

Similarly, 2 is related to

**⇒ (2 × 3) + 5**

**⇒ 6 + 5 = 11.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: If 11th June 1987 is Thursday. then what will be the day of the week on 4th Dec 1989?
questions.solution:
Given: **11th June 1987 was Thursday.**

Now,

1987 to 1989 = 2 Years (1 Ordinary Year and 1 Leap Year).

So, 1 Leap Year has 2 odd days,

And, 1 Ordinary Year has 1 odd day.

Total odd days = 2 + 1 = 3.

then, 11th June 1989 will be Thursday + 3 = Sunday.

Now, the number of days between 11th June 1989 to 4th Dec 1989

= 19(June) + 31(July) + 31(August) + 30(September) + 31(October) + 30(November) + 4(December) = 176 days.

= 176 days → 176/7 = 25 week and 1 odd day.

So, **4th Dec 1989** will be Sunday + 1 = Monday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
What will come in the place of '?' in the following equation, if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

37 - 18 ÷ 6 + 325 × 25 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

According to the given question:

 
 

 Symbols
 Interchanged with
 
 

 **+**
 **−**
 
 

 -
 **+**
 
 

 ×
 **÷**
 
 

 ÷
 **×**
 
 

 

Given equation : 37 - 18 ÷ 6 + 325 × 25 = ?

Now if '+' and '-' are interchanged with '−' and '+' respectively, and '×' and '÷' are interchanged then:

⇒ 37 + __**18 × 6**__ - __**325 ÷ 25**__

⇒ 37 + __18 × 6__ - 13

⇒ __**37 + 108 **__- 13

⇒ __**145 - 13**__ = __**132**__

Hence, the correct answer is *'Option 1'.*

questions.question:
What will come in place of '?' in the following equation, if '-' and '×' are interchanged and '+' and '÷' are interchanged?

7 + 7 × 3 - 4 ÷ 5 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

According to the given question:

 
 

 Symbols
 Interchanged with
 
 

 **+**
 **÷**
 
 

 -
 **×**
 
 

 

Given equation : 7 + 7 × 3 - 4 ÷ 5 = ?

Now if '-' and '×' are interchanged and '+' and '÷' are interchanged then:

⇒ __**7 ÷ 7**__ - 3 × 4 + 5 = ?

⇒1 - __**3 × 4**__ + 5 = ?

⇒ __**1**__ - 12 __**+ 5**__ = ?

⇒ __**6 - 12**__ =** -6**.

Hence, the correct answer is *'Option 2'.*
